name: Azure role-based access control (Azure RBAC)
short_description: Azure RBAC is the authorization system built on Azure Resource Manager that grants access to Azure resources through role assignments combining a security principal, a role definition and a scope.

evidence.quote: Azure role based access control is really just a keycard, not a light switch.
you end up making eight role assignments, one for each machine on each account.
